sources.snippet: Ming Image 0.1 Design is a text-to-image model from inclusionAI aimed at graphic-design output, with an emphasis on legible text rendering inside the generated image. This model is free to use.

sources.title: AntLing open sources Ming-Image-0.1-Design family of 6B models
sources.snippet: The release also features two open-source Agent Skills: Ling UI Design Skill and Image-to-Editable-PPT Skill. According to the source, Ming-Image-.1-Design ranks #1 among open-weight models on Artificial Analysis's UI/UX Design leaderboard.

sources.title: Ming-Image-0.1-Design - crafiq.ai
sources.snippet: A primary strength of the model is its handling of text-rich environments. It is designed to render complex, legible characters and words within a visual scene, addressing a common failure point in traditional image generation.
